metadata.difficultyPolicy: Each subcategory has 100 exercises per grade. Difficulty stars are mixed inside each grade: 34 one-star, 33 two-star, 33 three-star exercises.
metadata.gradeProgressionPolicy: Grade 1 is concrete and simple. Higher grades increase number range, multi-step reasoning, vocabulary, units, geometry, time and measurement complexity.
metadata.answerPolicy: Every answer option display value and value must be unique inside the exercise. Shape answers use symbols, not shape names.
metadata.generatedPuzzlePolicy: Do not include sudoku or math_crossword here; those are generated in-app.
metadata.categoryPolicy: In v3.7, Time, Measurement, and Shapes and geometry are all under the Geometry main category.
metadata.diversityPolicy: v3.7 regenerates Math and Geometry exercises with stronger anti-repeat rules: no exact visible prompt duplicates within the same subcategory and grade for these regenerated categories.
